notes.note: My MCP Connections has a tab each for Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot: copy the URL, open the client in one click, or expand Manual instructions for the steps. Until a client is connected, that's all the page shows.

Release notes: the gift icon in the menu bar shows what changed in the last 14 days in MixOS and in the apps, connectors and theme you use, with a red dot on each one you haven't read. Release Notes in App Manager keeps them all.
